name: Luxury Minister
description: A camera-ready patron who presents private comfort as a difficult sacrifice for public service.

comebacks.weak: Your briefing clashes with my shoes.
comebacks.medium: I could live on that budget. My wardrobe couldn't.
comebacks.strong: Your facts are badly tailored. Send them back to geography.
